Citation Catalog v2 — profile-first

Review page, separate from the packet and the candidate list. Generated 2026-11-10 · 425 held citations with a PDF on file.
How it reads a paper. It first works out how the paper cites (bibliography format and the in-text style actually used: [n], (n), superscript, author-year), then looks for your publication's marker only in that style, so a list item "(3)" or a residue range "(38–60)" in a [n] paper is never mistaken for a citation. Page headers and page numbers are removed first. Reference column: the number your publication carries in that paper's reference list, how it is printed in the text, and the page of the list, so it can be found with the PDF open. Click a citation ID for the full details.
